protocol.start_state: Both arms load an identical captured physical state before each paired call; reset and hash costs excluded from compute interval
protocol.ordering: Alternating serial/parallel execution within pair; reverse arm traversal in block2
protocol.estimator: exp(median(log(serial_ms/parallel_ms))); paired percentile bootstrap2000 resamples, deterministic seed
protocol.limits: Single host; correlated hot pairs, no exclusive CPU isolation; CI is within-run descriptive uncertainty, not population or future-host confidence
